summary:
I finished the Windows-only Python platform shim. It lives in database/SDBASE/src/sdbase/_platform.py and is re-exported by tools/radios_platform.py, so every contract constant exists only once. The previous session's code was largely complete and correct, so I kept it and added only what was missing or wrong.

Why the 53 tests that passed on the PC failed under Wine at first:
- The module did not even import here. Wine's ntdll lacks the undocumented export RtlAreLongPathsEnabled, and the shim required it at import time. It is now bound optionally.
- After that, 20 of 53 tests failed. Each failure is explained by a Wine deviation from documented Windows behaviour, and each deviation has a probe script.

Code changes, mostly to match the current C layer (src/core/platform*.c):
- Paths that GetFullPathNameW turns into DOS devices (NUL, x\CON.txt) are rejected with EINVAL.
- A no-follow O_TRUNC now truncates only after the link check, so a link or OneDrive placeholder is never overwritten.
- Creating a name that is still "delete pending" is retried within the 2 s budget.
- fd handles of -1, -2 or 0 raise EBADF (-2 equals the GetCurrentThread pseudo handle).
- make_private now uses C's canonical form and C's two-step repair (DACL first, then owner). This takes over files an elevated run left owned by Administrators.
- A '"' in the program path of a child process is rejected, as in C.
- append_only combined with O_TRUNC raises ValueError.
- open_flags(nofollow=True) fails loudly instead of silently following links.
- Four unused constants were removed.

New API from the call-site survey:
- sync_tree(root): flushes every copied file. It is the Windows conversion of os.sync() in tools/radios_database.py, where os.sync() is the only durability step for the files copytree copied.
- spawn_detached(..., log_fd=fd), the keyword the tools spec uses.
- tools PRIVATE_ALLOWED_SIDS, the name the tools contract test uses.
- In tools: _load_shim compares real paths, open_log_append checks the opened fd instead of the path, and resolve_python rejects drive-relative and rooted values.

Tests: the suite grew from 53 to 58. New coverage includes device names and bad fds, no-follow truncate and create, a raw-LockFileEx region contract test, canonical make_private, sync_tree, the log_fd and quote checks, and the stricter resolve_python.

Results under Wine:
- Three runs of the real suite: 58 tests, 36 pass, and the same 22 fail every time. All 22 are proven Wine gaps; no run was flaky.
- With a scratch harness outside the repo that corrects only the unlock error code to the documented Windows value: 42 pass, 16 fail, identical over two runs. All six lock tests pass this way, including the cross-process and raw-region ones.
- Assertions that the Wine gaps cut off were re-run without the gap features: 6 of 6 groups pass.

Both import paths work:
- As the package submodule sdbase._platform. This was verified with a stand-in for the package, because sdbase/__init__ still fails on storage.py's `import fcntl` (engine area).
- By file path through tools/radios_platform.py, which reuses the already-loaded module.

The cross-check against the current include/radios/platform.h and src/core/platform*.c is in the api section.
api:
MODULE database/SDBASE/src/sdbase/_platform.py (Windows only: ImportError on non-win32 or CPython < 3.12). Imports only the stdlib plus ctypes, msvcrt and _winapi, and nothing from sdbase. Engine and app modules use `from . import _platform`. The tools module loads the same file by path. Errors are OSError subclasses built from the Win32 error with winerror kept; ELOOP = refused link, EINVAL = invalid name or DOS-device path, EBADF = closed fd. RETRY = the bounded backoff 5,10,20,40,80,160 ms, then 250 ms steps, 2.0 s total (SDBASE_FS_RETRY_SECONDS can override it, clamped to 0..60).

CONSTANTS
LOCK_SH=1 LOCK_EX=2 LOCK_NB=4 LOCK_UN=8; LOCK_REGION_OFFSET=0x4000000000000000 and LOCK_REGION_LENGTH=1 (aliases WIN_LOCK_OFFSET/WIN_LOCK_LENGTH); O_BINARY=0x8000; O_NOINHERIT=O_CLOEXEC=0x80; O_NONBLOCK=0; O_NOFOLLOW=0x00100000 and O_DIRECTORY=0x00200000 (shim-only bits understood by open_fd and refused by open_flags); PRIVATE_FILE_SDDL='O:{sid}D:P(A;;FA;;;{sid})(A;;FA;;;SY)(A;;FA;;;BA)'; PRIVATE_DIR_SDDL='O:{sid}D:P(A;OICI;FA;;;{sid})(A;OICI;FA;;;SY)(A;OICI;FA;;;BA)'; PRIVATE_TRUSTED_SIDS={S-1-5-18,S-1-5-32-544,S-1-3-4} (plus the token user and the object owner at runtime); PRIVATE_SENSITIVE_RIGHTS=0xF00D017F; RETRY_BUDGET_SECONDS=2.0; STOP_EVENT_PREFIX='Local\\RadioS-stop-'; PYTHON_FLAGS=('-E','-s','-B','-X','utf8'); CHILD_CREATIONFLAGS=CREATE_NO_WINDOW; DETACHED_CREATIONFLAGS=CREATE_NO_WINDOW|CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP|CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB (never DETACHED_PROCESS).

PATH STRINGS (no I/O)
- is_absolute(path)->bool: X:\ or X:/ or \\srv\share. False for \x, C:x, \\?\ and \\.\ paths, and non-str values.
- is_root(path)->bool: X:\ or \\srv\share, with or without a trailing separator.
- path_equal(a,b)->bool, alias same_path: separators unified, then CompareStringOrdinal ignoring case (NTFS rules; never str.lower/casefold); a trailing separator matters.
- is_inside(root,path)->bool: equal, or below root at a component boundary.
- normalize(path)->str: absolute, '\' separators, '.' and '..' resolved lexically, duplicate separators removed, \\?\ stripped, drive letter upper-case, no trailing separator except on roots; ValueError for ''.
- is_canonical(path)->bool: absolute, equal to normalize(path), and every component valid.
- component_valid(name)->bool, alias valid_new_name: same rules as C radios_path_component_valid. Not '', '.' or '..'; no control characters, DEL or \/:*?"<>|; no trailing '.' or space; not a reserved device name (CON PRN AUX NUL CONIN$ CONOUT$ COM0-9 LPT0-9 COM¹²³ LPT¹²³, any case, with any extension); no lone surrogates; at most 255 UTF-16 units.
- sanitize_component(text, fallback, *, limit=150)->str: maps arbitrary text to a valid name (controls dropped, reserved characters become '_', dots and spaces stripped, reserved stem gets a '_' prefix, empty gives fallback). ValueError for an invalid fallback.
- safe_relative_parts(relative)->tuple[str,...]: strict parser for '/'-separated stored relative paths. ValueError for '', NUL, '\', ':', a leading '/', or any invalid component.
- stored_path_flavour(value)->'windows'|'legacy-posix'|None (classifies persisted paths only).
- to_portable(rel)->str ('\' to '/') and from_portable(rel)->str ('/' to '\').
- long_paths_enabled()->bool (RtlAreLongPathsEnabled; False when the export is missing).

LINKS (symlink, junction or mount point = any name-surrogate reparse point; OneDrive, dedup and WOF placeholders are not links)
- stat_is_link(stat_result)->bool.
- is_link(path|stat_result|DirEntry)->bool, alias is_link_like: lstat semantics, False when missing.
- entry_is_link(DirEntry)->bool, alias entry_is_link_like.
- has_link_component(path)->bool: any existing component from the root to the leaf is a link.

OPENING (every fd is a binary, non-inheritable CRT fd)
- open_flags(flags, *, nofollow=False)->int: flags|O_BINARY|O_NOINHERIT for a plain os.open. ValueError for O_NOFOLLOW, O_DIRECTORY or nofollow=True.
- open_fd(path, flags, mode=0o666, *, nofollow=False, private=None, share_delete=True, deny_write=False, append_only=False)->int, alias os_open:
  - Opens with NtCreateFile using the core spec 4.3 mapping (CREAT/EXCL/TRUNC dispositions) and shares READ|WRITE|DELETE.
  - private=True creates with the private file SDDL; private=None does so when creating with (mode & 0o077)==0.
  - O_NOFOLLOW or nofollow=True: ELOOP when the last component is a link. A placeholder is reopened and must be the same object. O_TRUNC is applied after that check.
  - O_DIRECTORY gives a read-only directory fd; a directory without it raises IsADirectoryError.
  - O_APPEND keeps FILE_WRITE_DATA unless append_only=True (handle can only append). append_only needs O_APPEND and refuses O_TRUNC.
  - deny_write=True drops FILE_SHARE_WRITE.
  - Sharing violations and delete-pending creates are retried within RETRY.
  - ValueError for O_TEXT, O_TEMPORARY or unknown bits.
- open_regular(path, *, write=False, create=False, mode=0o600, nofollow=True)->int: OSError(EINVAL) when not a regular file.
- open_read(path, *, nofollow=False)->BinaryIO: share-delete reader.
- read_bytes_shared(path, *, limit=None)->bytes.
- open_beneath(directory, name, *, deny_write=True)->(fd, stat_result): openat replacement. name must be one valid component (else EINVAL). Neither the directory nor the file may be a link (ELOOP). The directory is pinned and the file opened relative to its handle; a regular disk file is required. A writer that still holds the file gives EBUSY.
- open_nofollow_path(path, flags=O_RDONLY, mode=0o666, *, private=None, deny_write=False)->int: walks every component from the root relative to the previous handle. ELOOP for a link anywhere; EINVAL for relative paths or ./.. components.
- mkstemp_private(dir=None, prefix='tmp', suffix='')->(fd, abspath): atomic private O_EXCL file.

DURABILITY, RENAME AND DELETE
- fsync(fd|file)->None: FlushFileBuffers. Pipes and consoles are a no-op; a read-only handle is flushed through ReOpenFile(GENERIC_WRITE) when possible.
- fsync_file(path)->None: opens O_RDWR no-follow and flushes.
- fsync_dir(path)->None: successful no-op (decision; NTFS journals metadata). FileNotFoundError when missing, NotADirectoryError for a file.
- fsync_tree(root)->None: fsync_dir(root).
- sync_tree(root)->int: NEW. Replaces os.sync() after bulk copies: fsync_file on every regular file below root, links neither followed nor entered. Root as a link gives ELOOP, root as a file NotADirectoryError. Returns the number of files flushed.
- replace(src, dst, *, timeout=None)->None:
  - FileRenameInfoEx with REPLACE_IF_EXISTS|POSIX_SEMANTICS|IGNORE_READONLY, falling back to the variant without IGNORE_READONLY, then to classic FileRenameInfo on FAT/exFAT/SMB.
  - Never follows the source.
  - RETRY on 32/33/1224, and on 5 or 183 when the destination is a file or delete-pending.
  - A directory destination raises IsADirectoryError at once; PermissionError after the budget.
- rename_noreplace(src, dst, *, timeout=None)->None, aliases link_noreplace and publish_dir_noreplace: never overwrites (FileExistsError, source untouched), files and directories, source consumed.
- unlink(path, *, missing_ok=False, timeout=None)->None: deletes a file or link (never follows) with POSIX semantics (classic fallback), clears read-only, RETRY. A real directory raises IsADirectoryError.
- unlink_quietly(path)->bool: never raises; logs and returns False when the file remains.
- rmtree(path, *, timeout=None, ignore_errors=False)->bool: handle-relative walk; links (including junctions) deleted but never entered; a link as root raises ELOOP; read-only files handled; one overall deadline. ignore_errors=True logs and returns False instead of raising.
- rmtree_quietly(path)->bool.

LOCKS (byte-identical to C radios_fd_lock)
- flock(fd|file, op)->None:
  - Always UnlockFileEx first (ERROR_NOT_LOCKED ignored), then LockFileEx on 1 byte at 0x4000000000000000 (OVERLAPPED Offset=0, OffsetHigh=0x40000000), EXCLUSIVE for LOCK_EX, FAIL_IMMEDIATELY for LOCK_NB.
  - Contention with LOCK_NB raises BlockingIOError(EAGAIN); LOCK_UN is idempotent; a bad operation raises ValueError.
  - Locks belong to the handle.
- lock(fd|file, *, exclusive=None, shared=None, blocking=True, timeout=None, poll=0.01)->None: exclusive by default; blocking=False tries once (BlockingIOError); timeout polls and raises TimeoutError.
- unlock(fd|file)->None.
- unlock_and_close(fd)->None.
- locked_file(path, *, exclusive, timeout=None, create=False, write=False, mode=0o600): context manager yielding a no-follow regular-file fd that holds the lock.
- pread(fd, length, offset)->bytes: ReadFile with OVERLAPPED, b'' at EOF, file position preserved.

SPACE AND ACCESS
- disk_usage(path)->(total, available_to_caller): uses the volume of a file's parent.
- disk_free(path)->int.
- dir_writable(path)->bool: lists the directory, then creates and deletes a hidden DELETE_ON_CLOSE probe file.
- acl_supported(path|fd)->bool: FILE_PERSISTENT_ACLS.

PRIVACY (core spec 5.2; equal to C)
- current_user_sid()->str.
- owned_by_current_user(path|fd|file, *, follow_links=False)->bool: owner == token user, or Administrators while the token is an effective administrator. False on volumes without ACLs or on PermissionError; FileNotFoundError propagates.
- is_private(target, *, follow_links=False, directory=False, exact_file_mode=False)->bool: owner rule plus no-others rule.
  - No-others rule: no NULL DACL; every effective allow ACE (types 0/5/9/11, not INHERIT_ONLY) that grants any of PRIVATE_SENSITIVE_RIGHTS names the user, owner, SYSTEM, Administrators or OWNER RIGHTS. Deny ACEs are ignored.
  - directory=True requires a directory; exact_file_mode=True requires a regular disk file.
  - Fails closed on FAT/exFAT.
- private_dir_ok(path)->bool.
- foreign_access(target, *, rights=PRIVATE_SENSITIVE_RIGHTS, follow_links=False)->list[str] (diagnostics; a NULL DACL gives ['S-1-1-0']).
- security_sddl(target, *, follow_links=False)->str (owner and DACL as SDDL).
- make_private(target, *, follow_links=False, directory=None)->None: radios_fd_make_private.
  - No-op when already canonical: owner is the user, no foreign grants, the user has FILE_ALL_ACCESS and no deny ACE.
  - Otherwise sets the protected private DACL (file or directory variant, inheritable ACEs propagate), then sets the owner to the user through a WRITE_OWNER reopen, which the new DACL allows.
  - ELOOP for a link, ENOTSUP without ACLs, ENOTDIR/EISDIR on a type mismatch, PermissionError when the object is foreign.
- mkdir_private(path, *, parents=False, exist_ok=False)->None: new directory with the private directory SDDL; parents are created with inherited ACLs. exist_ok=True on an existing directory: not a link (ELOOP), owned (else PermissionError), then make_private (Linux chmod 0700).
- mkdtemp_private(prefix='tmp', suffix='', dir=None)->str (prefix + 8 hex characters + suffix).
- temporary_directory(prefix='tmp', suffix='', dir=None): context manager; the private directory is removed by rmtree(ignore_errors=True), so a cleanup failure never masks the body's exception.

PROCESSES AND STOP (D6)
- ProcessInfo(pid, creation_ticks, image_path|None, argv|None).
- PinnedProcess.open(pid, *, terminate=False)->PinnedProcess|None: OpenProcess(QUERY_LIMITED|SYNCHRONIZE[|TERMINATE]); None for pid <= 4, a missing process or access denied.
  - Members: .pid, .creation_ticks, .identity, alive(), wait(timeout=None)->bool, exit_code()->int|None, terminate(code=1), image_path()->str|None, command_line()->list|None (NtQueryInformationProcess(60) + CommandLineToArgvW), request_stop()->bool (only while alive), close(); usable as a context manager.
  - The handle pins the pid, like a pidfd.
- process_identity(pid)->(pid, creation_ticks)|None: creation_ticks are 100 ns ticks since 1601 (GetProcessTimes); None once the process has exited.
- process_info(pid)->ProcessInfo|None.
- boot_time()->float: informational only, never compare it.
- stop_event_name(pid=None)->'Local\\RadioS-stop-<decimal pid>' (ValueError for anything other than an int in 0..2^32-1).
- StopEvent(): owner side. CreateEventW manual-reset, non-signalled, default security; a pre-existing object is reset, logged, and reported as .already_existed. Members: .name, .handle, is_set(), wait(timeout)->bool, reset(), close(); context manager.
- create_stop_event()->StopEvent.
- request_stop(pid)->bool: OpenEventW(EVENT_MODIFY_STATE)+SetEvent. False when the process has no stop channel; other errors raise. Verify identity first (PinnedProcess).
- StopRequest(*, console=True): SIGTERM/SIGINT replacement for long-lived processes.
  - install()/__enter__ creates the stop event and a watcher thread that sets .event (a threading.Event).
  - console=True (main thread): Ctrl+C/Ctrl+Break set .event instead of raising KeyboardInterrupt, and CTRL_CLOSE/LOGOFF/SHUTDOWN wait up to 4.5 s for .finished.
  - wait(timeout); close(); __exit__ sets .finished and closes; atexit-safe.

CHILD PROCESSES (D4)
- python_executable()->str: the bundled <root>\runtime\python\python.exe or <prefix>\python\python.exe (sys.executable when it is one of them; pythonw is mapped to python.exe). Never a PATH lookup.
- python_child_argv(*args)->[interp, -E, -s, -B, -X, utf8, *args].
- python_child_env(base=None)->dict: removes PYTHONHOME and PYTHONPATH (names compared case-insensitively), sets PYTHONUTF8=1, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8.
- popen_no_window(argv, **popen_kwargs)->Popen: CREATE_NO_WINDOW, close_fds=True so only the std handles are inherited (PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST). ValueError for a relative program, a '"' in the program path, .bat/.cmd, shell=True, close_fds=False, executable=, or DETACHED_PROCESS.
- spawn_detached(argv, *, cwd=None, env=None, stdout=None, stderr=None, log_fd=None)->Popen: DETACHED_CREATIONFLAGS, retried without BREAKAWAY on ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED. stdin is NUL; stdout and stderr are NUL unless given; log_fd sets both.

PROCESS SETUP AND TIME ZONES
- configure_process()->None: idempotent; SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS|SEM_NOOPENFILEERRORBOX, 8 MiB thread stacks, faulthandler on stderr.
- configure_stdio_utf8()->None.
- canonical_timezone(name)->str: exact-case IANA key from the bundled tzdata, or 'UTC'; otherwise zoneinfo.ZoneInfoNotFoundError.
- check_timezone_database()->None: RuntimeError with the Turkish message when tzdata is missing.

MODULE tools/radios_platform.py
- Re-exports every name in the shim's __all__ as the same objects (one module instance; it reuses sdbase._platform when that is already imported).
- Adds:
  - shim, SHIM_PATH; FLOCK_OFFSET=LOCK_REGION_OFFSET, FLOCK_LENGTH=1, PRIVATE_ALLOWED_SIDS=PRIVATE_TRUSTED_SIDS.
  - open_nofollow(path, flags, mode=0o600, *, private=False)->int.
  - open_log_append(path)->int: private, no-follow, append-only handle; the fd must be a regular file owned by the user, and is made private if it is not.
  - make_private_dir(path, *, parents=False, exist_ok=True).
  - private_mkstemp(dir, prefix='', suffix='')->(fd, path).
  - ensure_private_tree(path)->bool: makes a real, owned, ACL-capable directory tree private; True when it changed something.
  - publish_noreplace = rename_noreplace.
  - resolve_python(python_command, project_root)->str (D4):
    - An explicit path (absolute, or relative to the root) must exist and end in .exe, else FileNotFoundError (fail closed).
    - Drive-relative and rooted values raise ValueError.
    - ''/python3/python select runtime\python\python.exe, then python\python.exe.
    - Any other bare name raises ValueError; PATH is never searched.
  - python_argv(python_command, project_root)->[interp, *PYTHON_FLAGS].
  - display_command(argv)->str (list2cmdline).
  - boot_time_iso()->str.
  - no_proxy_opener()->OpenerDirector.
  - ProcessEntry(pid, parent_pid, name) and iter_processes()->Iterator[ProcessEntry] (Toolhelp32).
  - install_warnings(project_root)->list[str] (onedrive_folder, controlled_folder_access_risk, volume_without_acls, project_root_writable_by_others, long_path_budget).
  - make_public_for_tests(path, *, sid='S-1-5-32-545', rights=FILE_GENERIC_READ, inheritance=0)->None (C radios_platform_test_make_public).

CROSS-CHECK AGAINST THE CURRENT include/radios/platform.h AND src/core/platform*.c (MATCH unless noted)
- Locks: RADIOS_LOCK_SH/EX/NB/UN 1/2/4/8; RADIOS_LOCK_REGION_OFFSET 0x4000000000000000 and LENGTH 1 (the OVERLAPPED split is the same); UnlockFileEx before every lock, ignoring ERROR_NOT_LOCKED; ERROR_LOCK_VIOLATION/ERROR_IO_PENDING mean would-block; invalid op is EINVAL (C) or ValueError (Python).
- Open flags: RADIOS_O_NOFOLLOW 0x00100000, DIRECTORY 0x00200000, CLOEXEC 0x80, NONBLOCK 0, BINARY 0x8000.
- Private SDDL templates (init_security) and the sensitive mask of dacl_private (0xF00D017F).
- Privacy rules: trusted SIDs (user, owner, SY, BA, OWNER RIGHTS); allow ACE types 0/5/9/11 with object-ACE SID offset; INHERIT_ONLY skipped; NULL DACL not private; deny ACEs ignored for the no-others rule; owner rule including effective administrator; FILE_PERSISTENT_ACLS fail-closed.
- make_private: handle_is_canonical_private/dacl_user_full and the two-step DACL-then-owner repair (made identical in this session).
- Stop event: name "Local\\RadioS-stop-%lu", manual reset, ResetEvent on ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS; request_stop uses OpenEventW(EVENT_MODIFY_STATE), and FILE/PATH_NOT_FOUND means "no channel".
- Retry: RETRY_BUDGET_MS 2000 with steps 5..160 then 250; retryable statuses SHARING_VIOLATION/LOCK_NOT_GRANTED/FILE_LOCK_CONFLICT; delete-pending create retry (made identical).
- Rename: flag sequence and classic fallback; destination classification on 5/183 (a directory gives EISDIR).
- Delete: FileDispositionInfoEx DELETE|POSIX|IGNORE_READONLY with classic fallback.
- Paths: device-path guard in nt_path (made identical); no-follow truncate-after (made identical); root_length; path_equal and is_inside via CompareStringOrdinal; component_valid and reserved names; to_portable/from_portable; normalize equivalent (both lexical).
- Spawn: CREATE_NO_WINDOW, plus NEW_PROCESS_GROUP|BREAKAWAY when detached, retried without BREAKAWAY on ACCESS_DENIED; absolute program; '"' and .bat/.cmd rejected; handle list = std handles only; same child Python environment.
- fd handles -1/-2/0 give EBADF (made identical).

Intentional differences:
- A Python O_APPEND keeps FILE_WRITE_DATA unless append_only=True (app spec 2.2/7.1: os.ftruncate needs it); C drops it unless O_TRUNC.
- Python open_fd on a directory needs O_DIRECTORY (otherwise IsADirectoryError); C allows RDONLY.
- Python fsync on a read-only fd tries a writable reopen and flushes; C returns 0. Both succeed.
- Python opens do not add FILE_OPEN_FOR_BACKUP_INTENT (no effect without SeBackupPrivilege).
verification: Interpreter for everything: wrun /home/user/RadioSs/runtime/python/python.exe -E -s -B -X utf8 (CPython 3.14.8 embeddable under Wine 9.0). Linux python3 was used only to apply text patches and parse files for syntax.

Import paths, both OK after the fixes. (1) Package submodule from database/SDBASE/src: `from sdbase import _platform` gives module 'sdbase._platform', __package__ 'sdbase'. This used a namespace stand-in for the sdbase package, because sdbase/__init__ -> storage.py still runs `import fcntl` (engine area). tools.radios_platform then reuses that same module object (t.shim is p == True). (2) By file path from /tmp: radios_platform loads 'radios_sdbase_platform'. 105 shim exports and 125 tools exports, all resolvable.
Before the fix the shim failed to import under Wine (AttributeError: RtlAreLongPathsEnabled). After the fix, baseline run0 was 53 tests with 20 failures, all triaged to Wine gaps.

Final suite runs, plain (python.exe -E -s -B -X utf8 -m unittest -v test_sdbase_platform, cwd tests): runs 1, 2 and 3 each Ran 58, 36 ok, the same 22 failures every time (identical failing sets, md5 870cb9cd). All 22 are WINE-GAPs proven by probes (see open_issues). Logs: /opt/radios-port/work/py-python-shim/final-run{1,2,3}.log.

Scratch emulation harness /opt/radios-port/work/py-python-shim/emulation/run_with_unlock_emulation.py (not in the repo). It corrects only Wine's UnlockFileEx error 33 to the documented 158, in the parent and in the children through a patched copy. Two runs: Ran 58, 42 ok, the same 16 failures (md5 376a0be9). All lock tests pass this way: SH/EX/NB matrix in one process, locks across processes including a killed holder, the raw-LockFileEx region contract, the lock helpers, content I/O not blocked, and lock handles never leaking into a child or a detached grandchild.

Scratch check /opt/radios-port/work/py-python-shim/emulation/check_behind_gaps.py re-runs the assertions that the Wine gaps cut off, without the gap features: unlink tails, rmtree with read-only files and held files, open_beneath without junctions, the privacy round trip under the mode mapping, process identity and info apart from argv, and tools private_mkstemp. Result: 6/6 groups pass.

Contract tests pass against the current C sources: test_header_constants_match (lock and O_ constants parsed from include/radios/platform.h) and test_c_sources_match (SDDL templates, stop-event format, sensitive mask and RETRY_BUDGET_MS parsed from src/core/platform.c and platform_win32.c).

New tests pass under Wine: test_device_names_and_bad_descriptors, test_nofollow_truncate_and_create, test_sync_tree, test_spawn_argument_checks (quote in program, log_fd with stdout), and test_detached_child_outlives_its_parent_and_never_inherits_pipes (now spawns with log_fd). New tests that fail only on a Wine gap: test_region_matches_a_raw_lockfileex_holder (unlock gap; passes under emulation) and test_make_private_restores_the_canonical_form (descriptor mode mapping).
Turkish paths: every test runs inside 'Şarkılar İçerik ğüöç ı' with Turkish file names. A windowless child produces strict UTF-8 output and argv, and was verified to have no visible console window.

Other backend tests under Wine: 36 of 41 tests/test_*.py modules cannot import because engine/tools modules still `import fcntl`. test_packaging: 20 errors from os.O_DIRECTORY in tools/radios_package.py. test_gui_backend_coverage: 1 failure unrelated to the shim. test_data_playlists and test_database_setup hung until the 600 s timeout in shutil.copy2, because Wine lacks CopyFile2. No test file was edited for Linux assumptions; these failures belong to other areas.
No private SDBASE service was started: the sdbase package cannot be imported until the engine port removes fcntl.

Owned files are LF only (no CR bytes), UTF-8, and newline='\n' was used for every patch. No test output was written into the tree; temp directories are under C:\users\root\Temp (Wine) and /opt/radios-port/work/py-python-shim.
industrial_fixes: Import robustness: the shim bound ntdll!RtlAreLongPathsEnabled, an undocumented Windows 10 1607+ export, at import time. Without it the whole shim failed to import, and with it the whole service and tools. It is now optional, and long_paths_enabled() returns False when the export is missing.

Device-path injection: os.path.abspath (GetFullPathNameW) turns 'NUL', 'con', 'x\CON.txt' (Windows 10) into \\.\ devices, so open_fd, unlink, replace and friends could open the console or NUL. These paths now raise OSError(EINVAL), the same rule as nt_path() in platform.c.

No-follow O_TRUNC data loss: FILE_OVERWRITE combined with FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT overwrites a symlink or OneDrive placeholder itself. The open now runs without truncation, checks for a link or placeholder (ELOOP, or a same-object reopen), and only then truncates with FileEndOfFileInfo, as the C open_target() does. A test checks that the link and its target stay intact.
Delete-pending race: creating a name that another program deleted the classic way (still delete pending) failed at once. Creating dispositions now retry within the 2 s budget, like C.

Invalid-handle misuse: msvcrt.get_osfhandle returns -2 for the std fds of a process without a console, and -2 is also the GetCurrentThread() pseudo handle. flock, pread, fsync and the privacy checks could have operated on the thread handle. Handles of -1, -2 or 0 now raise EBADF, like C fd_handle().

make_private no-op condition: a file that was owner-only but not writable by the user (e.g. user:FR), or owned by Administrators after an elevated run, counted as 'already private' and was left as is. Linux fchmod(0600) would have normalised it, and the next non-elevated run would fail closed. The canonical check (owner = user, user has FILE_ALL_ACCESS, no deny ACE) now matches C. The repair sets the DACL first and the owner second through a WRITE_OWNER reopen allowed by the new DACL, so no SeTakeOwnershipPrivilege is needed. mkdir_private(exist_ok=True) now always canonicalises an owned directory (Linux chmod 0700).

Durability gap that would have appeared in the port: tools/radios_database.py _migrate_database relies on os.sync() to make the files shutil.copytree copied durable. A Windows no-op would silently drop that guarantee. The new sync_tree(root) flushes every copied file (no-follow, never enters links).

Command-line injection hardening: a '"' in the child's program path is now rejected (mirrors C). append_only combined with O_TRUNC is rejected instead of leaving the semantics undefined. open_flags(nofollow=True) raises instead of letting os.open silently follow links.

tools/radios_platform.py: _load_shim compares real paths, so the shim is never loaded twice through a different spelling (8.3, case, subst). open_log_append validates the opened fd (fstat) instead of re-reading the path (TOCTOU). resolve_python rejects drive-relative ('C:python.exe') and rooted ('\python\python.exe') values, which pathlib would otherwise resolve against another drive's CWD or the root of the drive.
D2b leftover removal: unused constants _STILL_ACTIVE (the spec forbids STILL_ACTIVE polling), _FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS, the _OWNER_RIGHTS_SID duplicate and the _FILE_READ_DATA alias.

Integrator / environment owner: ENV_CLOUD.md says 'Security descriptors are stored and returned'. This Ubuntu Wine 9.0 build writes no user.wine.sd xattrs, even though ext4 supports them. Every descriptor is synthesized from Unix mode bits: no 'P', no BA ACE, and Users or tolerated grants widened to an Everyone read ACE. So ACL creation code cannot be verified even by reading it back here (probe_security_descriptors.py). Either use a Wine build with xattr security-descriptor storage, or record ACL verification as PC-only.

Spec conflicts resolved per DECISIONS D6 (binding):
- Lock region 0x4000000000000000 (the engine and tools specs proposed 0x7FFFFFFF00000000; the old value appears only in a negative test).
- Stop event per pid, Local\RadioS-stop-<pid> (the tools spec used per-instance names).
- Private SDDL with an explicit O:<user SID> and user SID ACEs (the tools spec used OW).
- Pre-existing stop events are reset, as in C (the tools spec said refuse); StopEvent.already_existed lets a caller refuse.

Deliberate Python vs C contract differences, documented in the api section:
- O_APPEND keeps FILE_WRITE_DATA unless append_only=True.
- open_fd on a directory needs O_DIRECTORY.
- O_NOFOLLOW/O_DIRECTORY are real shim bits equal to RADIOS_O_* rather than 0, so open_fd honours them and never silently follows.
- is_private defaults to exact_file_mode=False, as in the app spec (the tools spec suggested True).
